name: zhixu
description: Deploy your own Zhixu knowledge workspace and use connected personal tools for source-grounded search and reviewable drafts.

interface.longDescription: Deploy your own Zhixu personal knowledge workspace on Sites. Connect the personal plugin generated by your own deployment to search source material and propose reviewable drafts and topic relationships. This skills package includes no shared MCP service and does not access the publisher's infrastructure. A supported Sites account and a separate connection to your own instance are required for data operations.
defaultPrompt: Help me deploy my own Zhixu workspace.
Search my connected knowledge and cite sources.
Collect this note as a draft for my review.

review.commerce_description: The package does not sell products or process payments. Users provide their own hosting resources.

publication.release_notes: Initial self-hosted knowledge skills release. No shared MCP or publisher resources.

zh-CN.subtitle: 部署自己的知识库，检索与审核资料
zh-CN.description: 在自己的 Sites 中部署知序并连接个人插件，在对话中检索原文、保留来源、收集待审核草稿和提出主题关系。本技能包不含共享 MCP，不使用作者站点资源。数据操作需要自己的实例与单独认证。
